newsitem.title: CHINA: SEG forecasts 30 pct rise in H1 net.
newsitem.headline: SEG forecasts 30 pct rise in H1 net.

text.p: Shenzhen SEG Co Ltd, one of China's biggest television tube makers, is likely to post a 30 percent year-on-year rise in net profits in the first half of 1997, a company official said on Monday.
In the first half of 1996, SEG reaped 60.2 million yuan in unaudited net profits, compared with 55.9 million for the same period in 1995.

Net earnings per share are likely to remain around the same level as the 1996 first-half level of 0.29 yuan even though SEG made a three-for-10 bonus issue based on 1996 profits, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Profits were expected to rise due to increased production and other investments, including the completion of a warehouse in Shenzhen, he said, but did not give details.
The official did not specify whether the estimates were based on international or Chinese accounting standards.
SEG's profits soared to 127.22 million yuan for the whole of 1996 from 100.05 million in 1995 based on international accounting standards.
